meta.title: Optimize welcome message latency by reducing sleep times and caching audio decoding
meta.body_summary: Reduce welcome message latency from 3-4 seconds to below 1000ms by caching audio decoding, reducing polling/output sleep times, and adding timing instrumentation.

perf_labels.notes: Devin proposed latency optimizations via cache and sleep reductions; PR was closed by maintainer within 3 minutes with no review feedback, likely due to missing real-world benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 20 changed lines across 2 files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It is a small-step performance PR that was closed without merge, likely due to missing testability or maintainer disinterest.

review_details.concern_detail: No human reviewer feedback; maintainer closed the PR immediately without comment.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce welcome message latency from 3-4 seconds to well below 1000ms.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated base64 decoding of welcome audio, and polling/output sleep delays.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR within minutes of creation with no review comment; possibly due to untestable perf claim or maintainer policy.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Optimization requires telephony testing which the agent could not perform locally; without evidence of improvement, maintainer closed the PR immediately. This illustrates the challenge of performance optimizations that need hardware-specific validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body acknowledges testing limitation (no local telephony possible) and provides only manual test plan; no benchmarking artifacts or before/after measurements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any further action by maintainer.

core_change_summary.description: In task_manager.py, cached welcome_message_audio to avoid repeated base64 decoding, reduced polling sleep from 10ms to 1ms for stream_sid, and reduced output processing sleeps from 100ms to 10ms. Added timing logs for welcome message processing. In telephony.py, added timing log for audio transmission.
change_trajectory: Single commit implementing all changes: caching, sleep reductions, and instrumentation.
